locations.note: The game opens in a medical facility in Virginia, which Vattic escapes.
Vattic breaks Jayne Wilde out of the mental asylum where she is held in Vermont.
Jayne Wilde leads Vattic to Starke's hideout in Queens, where Starke tells him what really happened in Siberia.
At the headquarters of Hanson's National Security Executive in New Jersey Vattic finds evidence and confronts Hanson.
In flashbacks Vattic goes with the Marine taskforce WinterICE to Siberia to recover the defecting scientist Victor Grienko.

routes.name: Vattic
routes.note: From the Virginia facility through Vermont, Queens and New Jersey, with flashbacks to Siberia.
